title: Establishment of the Wu Zhou
shortSummary: The political transition of 690 changed imperial representation, the two-capital system and the allocation of religious resources.
curatorialDescription: The event avoids explaining complex policy with a single pro-Buddhist label and instead anchors edicts, images and institutions in time.
researchNote: Policies, rituals, texts and image projects require separate citations; motives are not inferred from identity alone.
